notes:
Pass on the fake backend: python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/maniparena__maniparena-sim --backend fake exited 0; every gate G1-G9 passed and the only warning is the expected G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (the package declares no Limit because the action width and bounds belong to the configured embodiment, so SAFE-014 has nothing to probe). Evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run wD-087) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached, no hardware or sim backend was passed to the gate, and the upstream stack was never installed or run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card proposes the GymnasiumDriver family-config, but the clone has no registered Gymnasium env id and no environment class of its own; build_sdk_ros2_gym_env is a builder function returning (gym_env, embodiment) (src/maniparena_sim/environment/sdk_builder.py:106-107) and AssembledEnvironment.build_gym_environment uses a name that IsaacLabArenaEnvironment registers at composition time (src/maniparena_sim/environment/assembled_environment.py:103), so a config-only GymnasiumDriver cannot name it from configuration. The package is a direct Driver over the card's class entry symbol AssembledEnvironment with the package fake; the driver calls get_env/build_gym_environment, and FakeAssembledEnvironment defines only those two public methods (both exist upstream at assembled_environment.py:180 and :63). cap.world.step.v1 takes ticks and action {values}; the driver validates the vector against the live environment action_space because the width depends on the configured robot and arm_control mode. cap.world.reset.v1 forwards seed and options and serves only the default scenario. cap.world.seed.v1 records the seed used by the next reset. No Limit is declared: the catalogue class owns the ticks and seed bounds, and no action bound is invented for a payload-selected action space. NOT COVERED: the real Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab / IsaacLab-Arena simulator, which needs Isaac Sim 6.0.1.0 wheels, Linux and an NVIDIA GPU (README.md:36-44; docs/install.md:13). The fake is a kinematic F0 stand-in with no physics, contacts, actuators, sensors, cameras or rendering; it returns a four-value policy group and a twelve-value placeholder action Box, so its arrays are smaller than the device's (all fake numbers are test data, not facts or limits). No sim backend is shipped and the real path was not run. Snapshot and restore are not offered. timestep_ms 50.0 is the default physics_dt 1/120 s times decimation 6 (src/maniparena_sim/environment/sdk_builder.py:45-49 and :173). License: the card records NOASSERTION/unknown and the clone has no LICENSE file; README.md:258 states Apache License 2.0, and the lock keeps NOASSERTION, so publish_review remains required. The clone stayed read-only at commit bc40c5f7c0f58ca86a53a2ab1a45a8e5a4a0916b; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
